title: The Thread Cannot Be Recut
prompt: The Weaver spins a second thread from the first and lays them side by side. Call what each one holds.

steps.note: A new thread, spun from the first.
Untouched. .upper() never reaches back and edits the original — that is what immutable means.
Still not an edit: a NEW string was woven, and the name word was pointed at it instead.
And big never moved. It holds its own thread, cut long before.

config.success: Two threads, never one. A string is never recut — it is respun, and old names keep what they were given.
